definitions.explanation: To physically walk toward someone or something.

definitions.gloss: to compromise, to make concessions, to meet halfway
definitions.explanation: To adjust one's position or opinion to reach agreement. Often implies mutual effort from both sides to bridge differences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}ってきた。
{子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧そば⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: The child walked up to the mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見知|みし}らぬ→見知る：14589_mishiru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}ってきた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{緊張|きんちょう}した→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧。
examples.english: I got nervous when a stranger slowly approached me.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}ること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to meet each other halfway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{双方|そうほう}→双方：11859_souhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}らなければ⟦{解決|かいけつ}しない→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: It won't be resolved unless both sides make concessions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{労使|ろうし}→労使：27897_roushi⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{経営側|けいえいがわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ようやく{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}る⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: In the labor-management negotiations, the management side finally showed a willingness to compromise.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb (⟦{歩|あゆ}む→歩む：13196_ayumu⟧ + ⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧). The figurative sense of compromising is the more common usage in modern Japanese. Conjugates as a godan verb: {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}らない, {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}ります, {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}って.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}る: to compromise with each other
- {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}る⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: willingness to compromise
- ⟦{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り→歩み寄り：09145_ayumiyori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show willingness to compromise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{妥協|だきょう}する→妥協する：17188_dakyousuru⟧: to compromise (more direct, can imply reluctant concession)
- ⟦{譲歩|じょうほ}する→譲歩する：17958_jouhosuru⟧: to make a concession (formal, one-sided yielding)
